key_facts: dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone
flare of symptoms with taper below 10 mg
previous treatments included hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab without improvement
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate on skin biopsy
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes on skin biopsy
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample

raw.rationale: The presence of atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes on skin biopsy, low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining, and clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample support this diagnosis. The patient's symptoms and response to prednisone also align with this condition.

rejected.label: Mycosis Fungoides
rejected.why: Typically presents with CD4+ lymphocytes, whereas this patient has a low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Characterized by muscle inflammation and distinctive skin findings such as Gottron's papules, which are not mentioned in the vignette
